body.purpose: Default UI copy, messages, drawer fields.

mono.purpose: Stats strip, chips, code blocks, token counts.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Primary message submit; black square with light icon.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-send-btn" aria-label="Send message"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M22 2L11 13" /><path d="M22 2L15 22L11 13L2 9L22 2Z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: oklch(0% 0 0); border: none; border-radius: 10px; color: oklch(100% 0.00011 271.152); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-send-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: oklch(100% 0.00011 271.152); border: 1px solid oklch(0% 0 0); } .ds-send-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-send-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Top bar and sidebar chrome control.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Settings"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /><path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(28.094% 0.00003 271.152); border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(31.714% 0.00004 271.152); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { border-color: oklch(0.34 0.028 250); color: oklch(100% 0.00011 271.152); background: oklch(0% 0 0); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0% 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Message Input
components.description: Composer textarea in the input bar.
components.css: .ds-msg-input { width: 100%; background: oklch(100% 0.00011 271.152); border: 1px solid oklch(28.094% 0.00003 271.152); border-radius: 10px; color: oklch(31.714% 0.00004 271.152); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 11px 14px; outline: none; resize: none; line-height: 1.55; min-height: 44px; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-msg-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0% 0 0); } .ds-msg-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.62 0.025 250); }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.css: .ds-stat-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.34 0.028 250); color: oklch(0.62 0.025 250); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stat-chip span { font-weight: 700; } .ds-stat-chip--g { color: oklch(0.72 0.14 155); border-color: oklch(0.72 0.14 155 / 0.35); }

components.name: User Message Bubble
components.description: User turn in the chat column.
components.html: Hello from the bench.
components.css: .ds-msg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; max-width: 100%; } .ds-bubble { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; line-height: 1.65; font-size: 14px; background: oklch(88.769% 0.2563 138.508 / 0.336); color: oklch(31.714% 0.00004 271.152); border-bottom-right-radius: 6px; }

narrative.overview: SpeedChat reads like a light workbench: white surfaces, ink-black controls, and borders instead of stacked cards. Conversation is the focus; stats are instrumentation underneath. Depth uses borders and subtle gray fills, not decorative shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Light OKLCH neutrals with ink-black accent
JetBrains Mono for metrics and code
Flat chrome; mobile sidebar shadow only
Semantic metric colors never used for navigation chrome

rules.name: The Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: Black accent appears on primary actions, selection, and links. It does not tint large backgrounds except the logo mark and send button.

rules.name: The Metric Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red are for measurement only. Never use them for navigation chrome or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The 72ch Rule
rules.body: Assistant markdown bubbles cap at min(720px, 72ch) for readable line length.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Top bar, sidebar, input bar, and stats strip do not use box-shadow at rest.

dos: Do use OKLCH tokens from :root in index.html
Do use (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) for hover-heavy styles
Do treat stats as instrumentation with mono and tabular nums
donts: Don't use neon cyber HUD patterns
Don't mimic generic ChatGPT clones with cream cards or purple gradients
Don't build hero-metric dashboards with colored top stripes
Don't use glassmorphism or gradient text
Don't add colored border-left stripes on cards or alerts
Don't assume a dark theme for new screens
